mapper.delete: /* BmsChargeMapper.deleteBmsStorageRate : 보관료 삭제 */ delete from TB_BMS_STORAGE_RATE WHERE STORAGE_RATE_NO = #{storageRateNo}
mapper.select: /* BmsChargeMapper.selectBmsWorkRateDetailList : 작업료 조회 */ SELECT A.WORK_RATE_NO , A.APPLY_DATE , A.APPLY_CLASS , A.PAY_BASIC , A.PAY_MIN , A.OVER_WEIGHT , A.OVER_PRICE , A.WT_MIN , A.ASSIGN_OVER_PRICE , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME FROM TB_BMS_WORK_RATE A WHERE 1=1 AND A.APPLY_DATE = #{srchApplyDate} AND A.APPLY_CLASS = #{srchApplyClass}
mapper.delete: /* BmsChargeMapper.deleteBmsWorkRate : 작업료 삭제 */ delete from TB_BMS_WORK_RATE where WORK_RATE_NO = #{workRateNo}
mapper.select: /* BmsChargeMapper.selectBmsStorageRateDetail : 보관료 상세 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 STORAGE_RATE_NO , APPLY_DATE , APPLY_CLASS , STORAGE_START_DAYS , STORAGE_END_DAYS , AMOUNT_BASIC , AMOUNT_OVER , WEIGHT_BASIC , WEIGHT_OVER , PAY_MIN , WT_MIN , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME FROM TB_BMS_STORAGE_RATE A where (1=1) AND STORAGE_RATE_NO = #{srchStorageRateNo}

/* BmsChargeMapper.selectBmsWorkRateDetail : 작업료 상세 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 WORK_RATE_NO , APPLY_DATE , APPLY_CLASS , PAY_BASIC , PAY_MIN , OVER_WEIGHT , OVER_PRICE , WT_MIN , ASSIGN_OVER_PRICE , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME FROM dbo.TB_BMS_WORK_RATE A where (1=1) AND A.APPLY_DATE = #{srchApplyDate} AND A.APPLY_CLASS = #{srchApplyClass}

/* BmsChargeMapper.selectBmsStorageRateBase : 작업료 반입일자, 보관일수, 요율구분에 따른 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 STORAGE_RATE_NO , APPLY_DATE , APPLY_CLASS , STORAGE_START_DAYS , STORAGE_END_DAYS , AMOUNT_BASIC , AMOUNT_OVER , WEIGHT_BASIC , WEIGHT_OVER , PAY_MIN , WT_MIN , CASE WHEN #{srchStorgeDays} BETWEEN A.STORAGE_START_DAYS AND A.STORAGE_END_DAYS THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS STORAGE_DAYS_CHECK FROM TB_BMS_STORAGE_RATE A WHERE A.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(APPLY_DATE) FROM TB_BMS_STORAGE_RATE WHERE APPLY_DATE <= #{srchCarryinDate} AND APPLY_CLASS = #{srchApplyClass} )/* 반입일자 작은것중에 MAX */
AND A.APPLY_CLASS = #{srchApplyClass} ORDER BY STORAGE_DAYS_CHECK, STORAGE_END_DAYS DESC

/* BmsChargeMapper.selectBmsWorkRateBase : 작업료 상세 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 WORK_RATE_NO , APPLY_DATE , APPLY_CLASS , PAY_BASIC , PAY_MIN , OVER_WEIGHT , OVER_PRICE , WT_MIN , ASSIGN_OVER_PRICE FROM TB_BMS_WORK_RATE A WHERE A.APPLY_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(APPLY_DATE) FROM TB_BMS_WORK_RATE WHERE APPLY_DATE <= #{srchCarryinDate} AND APPLY_CLASS = #{srchApplyClass} ) /* 반입일자 작은것중에 MAX */ AND A.APPLY_CLASS = #{srchApplyClass} /* 요율구분 */
